meta.name: planning
meta.description: Create and manage persistent markdown planning files for structured task execution. Use when the user asks to "create a plan", "track progress", "start a research project", or when a task requires more than 5 tool calls and needs structured phase tracking to stay focused and avoid goal drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并管理结构化任务计划，跟踪执行进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将复杂任务拆解为分阶段计划并持续追踪
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage structured task plans with progress tracking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often break down complex tasks into phased plans and track progress

howto.what: Claude 会创建三个 markdown 文件（task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md）来记录任务目标、阶段、发现和进度，确保多步骤复杂任务中不丢失上下文。
howto.when: 当你要求“制定计划”、“跟踪进度”或“开始研究项目”，或者任务需要超过5次工具调用且需要结构化阶段跟踪时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude creates three markdown files (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md) to track goals, phases, discoveries, and progress, preventing context loss during complex multi-step tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "create a plan", "track progress", "start a research project", or when a task requires more than 5 tool calls and needs structured phase tracking.
